## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem, trigger, and resulting behavior.

## Reference evidence and scope

Identify original behavior evidence, input identity, starting state, and known
exclusions. State whether this changes original behavior, tooling, or an optional mod.
For behavior comparisons, use the [compatibility report template](https://github.com/BaileyPillon/lsd-dream-emulator-bevy/blob/main/docs/templates/COMPATIBILITY_REPORT.md).

## Validation

List the relevant commands/scenarios and their results. Distinguish public CI
checks, local original-input comparisons, and complete accepted scenarios.

## Remaining work

Describe material limitations and any dated parity-tracker updates.
Link the related issue. Use a closing keyword only when all of its acceptance
criteria are met.
